title: 第23章 你该叫我师伯第24章 母亲的师门三更求月票
content_zh:
;;
370万星币，这个数字令方羽心中屏息……别看这一个多月来他花销大，似乎几十万星币都不算什么。
但这都是有原因的。
方平安是拿出全部家底提供宝物，助方羽最后冲刺专升本考核……方家，已经算小有积蓄的家庭。
武陵市武道大专提供的100万星币，本质上，也蕴含学校的一种鼓励。
能从大专重新考入本科，某种意义上培养价值本就超越了一般武道本科生。
学校也希望，这些精英学生将来强大，能够回馈母校，几十个里面能诞生一位大地武者，都值得了。
方羽现在其实很缺钱，他的银行卡里现在还不到10万星币……之前他辛苦做一年助教，不算最后的辞退补偿，总共才赚十来万星币。
武者们。
若不去原初星搏杀，光靠正常岗位工资，赚钱效率并不高……毕竟，蓝月联盟内部秩序稳固，武者的强大武力用处并不大。
大部分高级武者们，正常工作，年薪也就百万上下。
当然，方羽之前一年花销50万星币，主要原因还是因为他无法吸收星力……若能觉醒星相，吸收星力淬体，保持同等进步速度，花销要小很多。
370万星币。
是一笔很惊人的财富，足以让普通人基本达到财富自由，更能缓解方羽接下来修炼所需，甚至能一定程度上反哺家里。
可方羽并未被喜悦冲昏头脑。
“唐副教授。”方羽道：“能让我看一下合约么？”
一旁女老师想要出声提醒。
制式合同，看与不看区别不大。
“行，你先看。”唐副教授丝毫不介意。
方羽一步上前，快速翻阅起来，上面的条款并不多，没有会产生误区的地方，其中几条引起了方羽的注意。

“在校期间，非重大不可抗力因素，必须参加每年的‘原初星实战’，且必须达到最低要求（见附件），并将文明积分归属统计于‘湖广武道大学’，若无法达到最低要求，需返回额外培养资金……”
“在校期间，若觉醒上位星相，即可无条件晋升为‘大地合约’，并进入大地院修行。”
“大四期末考核结束前，任何一次季度考核排名冲入前50，且完成原初星实战要求，即可晋升为‘大地合约’，并进入大地院修行。”
“在大四期末考核结束前，最后一次季度考核，若排名500名后，则解除精英合约……”
“在校期间，若被其他武道大学邀请加入，则需赔偿违约金‘5000万’。”
“在校期间，若通过‘本升研’考核，考取新月武道大学或十所重点武道大学研究生，无条件解除合约。”
有好处，每年的培养资金，以及学校内更优秀的师资等。
有责任，必须参加实战。
违约金也很高昂。
可同样的，若方羽表现足够优秀，合约也会进一步升级……以方羽的角度，这是一份非常合理的合约了。
抬起头。
“唐副教授，即将到来的实战任务，是8.20号开始吧。”方羽询问道，“我也要参加吗？很多课程大专里是没开设的。”
“要参加。”

3.7 million star coins, this number made Fang Yu hold his breath... Even though he had spent a lot in the past month or so, it seemed that hundreds of thousands of star coins were nothing.
But it's all for a reason.
Fang Ping'an used all his family wealth to provide treasures to help Fang Yu in his final sprint for the junior college to bachelor's degree exam... The Fang family was already considered a family with a small amount of savings.
The 1 million star coins provided by Wuling City Martial Arts College essentially also contains an encouragement from the school.
Being able to re-enter the undergraduate program from junior college, in a sense, the value of training exceeds that of ordinary martial arts undergraduates.
The school also hopes that these elite students will be strong in the future and be able to give back to their alma mater. If an earth warrior can be born among dozens of them, it will be worth it.
Fang Yu is actually very short of money now. He currently has less than 100,000 star coins in his bank card... He worked hard as a teaching assistant for a year before, and not counting the final compensation for dismissal, he only earned a total of about 100,000 star coins.
Warriors.
If you don't go to the Primordial Star to fight, just relying on normal job wages is not very efficient in making money... After all, the internal order of the Blue Moon Alliance is stable, and the powerful force of the warriors is of little use.
Most senior warriors, with normal work, have an annual salary of around one million.
Of course, the main reason why Fang Yu spent 500,000 star coins in the previous year was because he was unable to absorb star power... If he could awaken the stars, absorb star power to temper his body, and maintain the same progress rate, the cost would be much smaller.
3.7 million star coins.
It is an astonishing amount of wealth, which is enough to allow ordinary people to basically achieve financial freedom, and can also alleviate Fang Yu's subsequent cultivation needs, and can even feed back his family to a certain extent.
But Fang Yu was not carried away by the joy.
"Associate Professor Tang." Fang Yu said, "Can you let me see the contract?"
The female teacher on the side wanted to remind her loudly.
For a standard contract, there is not much difference between whether you read it or not.
"Okay, you take a look first." Associate Professor Tang didn't mind at all.
Fang Yu stepped forward and flipped through it quickly. There were not many clauses on it, and there were no misunderstandings. Several of them caught Fang Yu's attention.
“During school, if there are no major force majeure factors, you must participate in the annual ‘Original Star Combat’ and must meet the minimum requirements (see attachment), and the civilization points will be attributed to ‘Huguang Martial Arts University’. If you cannot meet the minimum requirements, you will need to return additional training funds...”
"While in school, if you awaken to the higher astrology, you can be unconditionally promoted to the 'Earth Contract' and enter the Earth Academy to practice."
"Before the final assessment of the senior year, if you reach the top 50 in any quarterly assessment and complete the original star actual combat requirements, you can be promoted to the 'Earth Contract' and enter the Earth Academy to practice."
"Before the final assessment of the senior year, the last quarterly assessment, if you rank below 500, the elite contract will be terminated..."
"While in school, if you are invited to join by other martial arts universities, you will be required to compensate '50 million' in liquidated damages."
"While in school, if you pass the 'Bachelor's and Postgraduate' examination and get admitted as a graduate student at Crescent Martial Arts University or ten key martial arts universities, your contract will be terminated unconditionally."
There are benefits, including annual training funds and better teachers in the school.
Have responsibility and must participate in actual combat.
Liquidated damages are also very high.
But similarly, if Fang Yu performs well enough, the contract will be further upgraded... From Fang Yu's perspective, this is a very reasonable contract.
Lift your head.
"Associate Professor Tang, the upcoming practical mission will start on August 20th." Fang Yu asked, "Do I also want to participate? Many courses are not offered in junior colleges."
"Want to participate."
